content:
Go Change the World!

From the ORA eTraining module "Post Award Quick Guide" (lesson 9 of 9).
ORA is Here for You
The Office of Research Administration would again like to congratulate you on receiving this funding. Our office prides itself on delivering the most optimal customer experience possible and we are excited to work with you on your project! Your work directly contributes to our skyrocket towards R1 Carnegie status and we couldn't be more appreciative. Some of you may have more support than others, but we want to encourage all of you to use our staff as a resource to help reduce your administrative burden so you can focus on what you do best: performing research that will change the world! If you have any questions related to your project please feel encouraged to contact us at ask.ora@morgan.edu .
